entries.content:
"Exposition Swing" is titled "Black Out" on Vo(E) S.50.

NDESOR lists Billy Taylor on bass on the first title, two basses on the second and Hayes Alvis on the third one. Leonard Feather wrote on "The Melody Maker", 15 Aug 1936: «The two bassists took it in turns, Taylor playing the first side, Alvis the second and Taylor the third.» In the Mosaic MD11-248 booklet, p. 21, Steven Lasker writes: «Although discographies show Alvis absent from the first title and Taylor absent from the third, the ledger shows both bassists present on all three titles.»
